NOTE: this file is hand-written, unlike its siblings in this directory which are
verbatim captures of the published packages. It covers lines that cannot be
captured without a real Microsoft account: a successful login, and the two MFA
challenges. The strings are quoted from the package sources, not invented:

  microsoft-webauth/src/auth.js:1471   logger.step(`  Enter the number:  ${...}`)
  microsoft-webauth/src/auth.js:1488   promptUser('Enter the verification code: ')
  microsoft-webauth/src/auth.js:1572   logger.success(`Authentication successful! ...`)

The point of saying so is that these lines are unverified against a live login.
If the MFA flow misbehaves in production, this file is the first place to look -
and the captures beside it are the ones known to be real.
